cumleler: Can you hear your own breathing in your ear?
The Eustachian tube is normally closed at rest.
A closed tube keeps our own voice from reaching the middle ear.
Rarely, it stays open too much; this is a patulous Eustachian tube.
The person hears their own voice and breath echo; this is autophony.
